blurb: Guests participate in guided rafting or kayaking trips on various rivers with different difficulty levels, from easy whitewater to extreme river trips. Trips include safety briefings, equipment fitting, and are led by professional guides with safety kayakers on challenging trips. Food is provided after some trips, and photos are taken by a photographer on every trip.
